name: Jukubo Onsen
source:
Yusaku lives with his mother, Shouko. He lost his father a few years ago, and they have been living together since then. One day, he gives her a present. He takes her to a spa hotel, and they stay one night there. Their peaceful day at the hotel is almost over, but they accidentally see a hotel staff member having sex with a young man. They get sexually excited, and....
